subject: Technical preview: propose times & calendar handoff
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Shepard <alex.shepard@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical preview: propose times & calendar handoff

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we can set up a short technical preview (30–45m) with engineering next week: 

- Primary use case: low-latency inference for patient triage workflows (50–100 concurrent requests).
- Success metrics you called out: 95th pct latency < 400ms and cost budget ~ $0.002/token.
- Security notes: data residency in the US, SOC2 compliance required, and an internal security contact (see below).

Proposed next steps: 1) 30–45m technical preview so our infra/serving engineer can validate performance profile and KV cache behavior; 2) share a short agenda and invite.

Please indicate which of these windows works in PT (we'll send a calendar invite with Zoom):
- Tue 2026-11-16 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue 2026-11-16 — 11:00–11:45 PT
- Wed 2026-11-17 — 09:00–09:45 PT

Also confirm these items before we lock the invite:
- Final attendee roster (who from ClearHealth will join; please include the security contact).
- Any specific infra constraints (VPC, private link, IP allowlist) we should plan for in the demo environment.

I've attached a short preview agenda and a mutual action plan (stub) to help structure the call. Once you confirm a time and attendees I'll send the calendar invite with the Zoom link and the agenda attached.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Irene —

Thanks for the recap and for pulling the MAP together. All helpful.

We can do Tue 2026-11-16 11:00–11:45 PT. Please include our security lead Priya Natarajan (priya.n@clearhealth.com) and our infra lead, Alex Kim (alex.kim@clearhealth.com).

Tentative agenda notes from our side: 
- Short 10m product recap / success criteria alignment
- 20m infra/throughput discussion (KV caching, batching)
- 10m Q&A and next steps (P0 blockers, procurement timeline)

Also: can you flag whether the preview will use a synthetic dataset or a hashed subset of our data? We prefer a hashed subset if possible.

Appreciate it — Alex
